title: Review against standards and spec
prompt: Review this branch against main. Tell me if it follows the repo standards and whether it actually implements the PRD.
required_behaviors: Resolve the comparison base and use a merge-base diff.
Find standards documents and spec/PRD source.
Separate Standards findings from Spec findings.
Cite file/line or source references for each finding.
Report missing spec as a limitation rather than pretending.
forbidden_behaviors: Merge standards and spec concerns into one vague list.
Assume the PRD from branch name without evidence.
Say no issues without noting test gaps or residual risk.
